the LHC experiments can probe the existence of leptoquark states with masses up to 3.2 TeV, depending on the renormalisation/factorization scale choice.

the production cross section for leptoquark pairs can be reduced by a factor of 2 to 3 if the higher-order QCD effects are taken into account.
